entities.summary: HD 212301 b is an extrasolar planet located approximately 172 light-years away in the constellation of Octans, orbiting the star HD 212301. It has an orbital period of 2.25 Earth days. The orbital distance is 0.0341 astronomical units or 5.10 gigameters.
